problemSigns.sign: Opener is 15+ years old with no safety sensors
problemSigns.detail: Older openers often lack modern safety sensors. This is a safety risk for family and pets. Current building codes require safety sensors for new installations.
Modern openers offer remote access and monitoring from your phone. You can open or close your door from anywhere, ensuring convenience and security.

problemSigns.sign: Need battery backup for power outages
problemSigns.detail: Power failures can leave your car trapped. A battery backup ensures your door operates during an outage, providing access when you need it most.

problemSigns.sign: Current opener too loud under a bedroom
problemSigns.detail: Loud chain-drive openers are disruptive, especially if a bedroom is above or near the garage. Belt-drive units operate much quieter, improving home comfort.

problemSigns.sign: Garage door not closing fully or sealing properly
problemSigns.detail: An aging or failing opener can prevent your garage door from fully sealing against the slab. This leaves gaps, impacting security, insulation, and weather resistance.
